name: mynrd-flow
description: Personal dev workflow toolkit — set a project up with /mynrd-init, plan a request with /mynrd-plan, refine drafts with /mynrd-refine, run the build loop with /mynrd-dispatch using specialist implementation agents, and close verified work with /mynrd-verified. Includes /mynrd-help with a grounded knowledge base. Fully local: no issue tracker or DevOps dependency.
